[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key features to look for in a dash cam:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Video Resolution: At least 1080p or 1440p.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Wide Angle Lens: 120° or more.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. GPS: Geotag footage and provide location data.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Wi-Fi: Easy video transfer to devices.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Impact Detection: Saves footage during an accident.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Night Vision: Improved low-light performance (WDR or HDR).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Parking Mode: Records when parked, with motion detection.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Loop Recording: Overwrites older files when memory is full.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. MicroSD Card Capacity: Large enough for several hours of footage.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Power Management: Low power consumption to minimize battery drain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for choosing a dash cam:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Consider mounting type, warranty, customer support, reviews, and budget.
